<h2>Evaluate sjSDM Cross-Validated Predictions</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Pools selected-candidate out-of-fold predictions within each repeat and
taxon, then calculates taxon and community predictive metrics.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>evaluate_sjsdm_cross_validated_predictions(
  data_predictions = NULL,
  epsilon = 1e-06
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_predictions">data_predictions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Long selected-candidate prediction table returned in the data-prediction
element of [run_sjsdm_selected_candidate_folds()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="epsilon">epsilon</code></td>
<td>
<p>Probability clipping tolerance passed to
[evaluate_binary_log_loss()]. Defaults to 1e-6.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Folds are pooled before metrics are calculated. Any non-ok prediction row
makes all metrics for that repeat and taxon incomplete. One-class pooled
responses retain the metric-specific undefined statuses from the binary
evaluators, while binary log loss remains evaluable.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing data_taxon_metrics and data_community_summary.
Taxon metrics have one row per repeat, taxon, and metric. Community
summaries contain the mean finite estimate across evaluable taxa for each
repeat and metric.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
evaluate_sjsdm_cross_validated_predictions(
  data_predictions = data_predictions
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
